function: Excluded (above_phy): the learned DNN of IOPO predicts binary task-offloading decisions in an IRS-assisted UAV MEC system; IRS phase shifts come from the Whale Optimization Algorithm, not learning (pp. 6, 9).
notes: Reason above_phy. p. 6: 'we introduce a deep learning-based offloading decision generation model'; the MLP outputs offloading probabilities per user and UAV (p. 7). The IRS phase shifts (P2) use a metaheuristic, p. 9: 'we follow [32] to employ the Whale Optimization Algorithm (WOA)', so no physical-layer decision is learned with the offloading. Transmit power is fixed and bandwidth equally shared (p. 4). If check 3 is read literally, no_learning would apply first.
